what: Human judgements on traced boundaries. The first ground truth this corpus has had.
how_to_read: Each entry names a page, which pipeline variant produced the ring, and whether a human judged that ring correct. 'correct' is about PLOT IDENTITY and extent, not pixel accuracy -- the reviewer was looking at the crop with the ring drawn on it.
why_it_matters: Every automatic figure in this project measures the ring against drawn ink. None of them can say the ink is the right ink. These labels can.
